'''Al Kharid''' is a large city in the north of the [[Kharidian Desert]], and the only desert city open to [[Free-to-play|non-members]]. Players in the city do not suffer from the [[Desert heat|desert effect]]. 

Al Kharid is popular among free-to-play players because it contains one of the closest [[Al Kharid bank|banks]] to a [[range]] and to a furnace, two reasonably close [[fishing spots]], and a [[tanner]], [[Ellis]]. Also popular is the nearby [[Al Kharid mine|mining site]], which contains almost all ores up to and including [[Adamantite ore|adamant]].

==Transportation==
[[File:Pay-toll.png|thumb|280px|[[Border Guard]]s at the Al Kharid gate.]]
*{{Plink|Amulet of glory}} — {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the palace.
*{{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — northern Al Kharid.
*{{Plink|Ring of dueling}} — [[Emir's Arena]], just north-east of Al Kharid.
*{{Plink|Ring of the elements}} — near to the [[Fire Altar]] entrance, north of the city.
*{{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[Rat Pits|Sorceress's Garden]]. Usable once every 20 minutes, and only after asking [[Osman]]/[[Selim]] if they need any help.
*{{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — [[Shantay Pass]], just south of the city.
*{{plink|Desert amulet 4|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[Kalphite Cave|Kalphite cave]], near the [[Shantay Pass]].
*{{Plink|Cowbell amulet}} — inside the [[Lumbridge cow field|cow field]], just beyond the western gate.
*{{Plink|Lumbridge Teleport}} — [[Lumbridge Castle]], decently west of the city.
From [[Lumbridge]], players can use the toll gate which costs either 10 [[coins]], or nothing if you have completed the [[Prince Ali Rescue]] [[Quests|quest]]. Alternatively, members can use the level 8 [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] to grapple to and from the [[Lumbridge Swamp]].

From [[Varrock]], players can go south via the road alongside the [[Al Kharid mine]]. Members can also get to Al Kharid via the one-way [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] from [[Zanaris]]' market area, which brings them to the bank.[[File:Zeke's Superior Scimitars..png|thumb|250px|[[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]]]]

== History ==
Al Kharid has a long history. Most recently, in the year 169, [[Prince Ali]], the Emir's son, was kidnapped by the infamous [[Lady Keli]], causing the greatly upset Emir to retreat to his private chambers. However, [[Chancellor Hassan]] was able to enlist an adventurer to rescue the prince. The city is still ruled by the [[the Emir|Emir]], although the vast majority of the work has been taken over by [[Hassan|Chancellor Hassan]] since the Emir's son was kidnapped.

Two other buildings, immediately east and west of the [[silk trader]], are decorated but have no known owner. There is also an empty tent west of [[Dommik]], containing nothing but a [[bucket]].

=== Vendors and stalls ===
[[File:Dommik's Crafting Store..png|thumb|250px|[[Dommik's Crafting Store.]]]]

[[File:Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar..png|thumb|250px|[[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]]]]

Al Kharid also features several vendors without their own building:

* [[Ali Morrisane]] is found east of the [[gem trader]] to the north-east of the city near the blue star [[Quests|quest]] [[icon]] {{SCP|Quest}}. He sells various [[items]], and, once [[The Feud]] is completed, he will open various other [[shop]]s if you set up merchanting opportunities for him.
* The [[Gem Trader|gem trader]] east of the gate to [[Lumbridge]] sells one cut and uncut sapphire and emerald, and will buy rubies and diamonds. Players can buy them if they've  they've been sold to the shop by someone else.
* [[Osman]], just outside the [[Al Kharid Palace|Al Kharid palace]], can replace lost [[Keris]] daggers for 20,000 coins after [[Contact!]]. Additionally, [[Thieving]] experience rewards can be claimed by trading in [[Sq'irkjuice|Sq'irk juice]] obtained in the [[Sorceress's Garden]] minigame.
* The [[silk trader]], north-east of the [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]], is a quick and easy way for newer [[members]] to gain small amounts of money. If the player is prepared to click through a lengthy dialogue, they can buy [[silk]] cheaply (3 [[coins]]) which can be sold for a profit at a [[general store]] other than the one in Al Kharid. If you refuse at the first time, he'll lower the price to 2 coins.

[[File:Ali's Discount Wares..png|thumb|250px|[[Ali's Discount Wares.]]]]

=== Skill training areas ===

* The [[Al Kharid Rooftop Course|Al Kharid Agility course]] is a [[Rooftop Agility Courses|rooftop course]] which can be started on the wall of [[Ellis]]' store building.
* The [[Al Kharid mine]], north of the city, contains rocks up to and including [[Adamantite ore|adamant ore]].
* There is a [[cactus patch]] on the east side of the city, used in the [[Farming]] [[Skills|skill]].
* The [[ferry]] just south of the bank can be used to reach the [[Tempoross]] [[Minigames|minigame]].
* The [[Fire Altar]], used in the [[Runecraft]] skill, is located just north of the [[Emir's Arena]]
* There is a [[furnace]] north of [[Al Kharid bank|the bank]]. In [[Free-to-play Melee training|free-to-play]], it is the second only to the [[Edgeville furnace]] in terms of closeness to a bank.
* The [[Sorceress's Garden]] can be accessed from the [[Sorceress]]' home near the Shantay PAss. It offers an alternative method for training [[Thieving]].

=== Other ===

* The [[Shantay Pass]] south of the city acts as a barrier between Al kharid and the rest of the desert. Players must buy a pass for {{Coins|10}} coins to pass through. They can also get thrown in the jail or sent to [[Port Sarim]] for belligerence.
* The [[Emir's Arena]] is a massive combat area found north-east of Al Kharid. The building acts as a [[Player killing|PvP]] arena which lets players fight under set rules or account types.

[[File:Al Kharid Rooftop Course (7).png|thumb|width=250x250|A player completing the [[Agility]] course.]]

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Al the Camel}}, who produces poems and prose.
* {{Chatl|Ali Morrisane}}, a trickster with whom trading is troublesome.
* {{Chatl|Apprentice}}, an eager enchantress who's spotted sweeping.
* {{Chatl|Avan}}, a jaunty gentleman with some gold-altering gloves.
* {{Chatl|Ayesha}}, who keeps cacti from collapsing.
* 5 {{Chatl|Banker (Al Kharid)|pic=Banker (Al Kharid, male) chathead|text=bankers}}, who facilitate finance.
* 2 {{Chatl|Border Guard|text=border guards}}, who guard the gate and garnish gold for going-through.
* {{Chatl|Cam the Camel}}, a camel characterised by calmness.
* 2 {{Chatl|Camel|text=camels}}.
* {{Chatl|Captain Dalbur}}, a gnome navigator.
* {{Chatl|Chancellor Hassan}}, an altruistic adjudicator of Al-Kharidian affairs.
* {{Chatl|Dommik}}, a connoisseur who closes on [[Crafting]] commodities.
* {{Chatl|Ellis}}, a low-cost leathermaker.
* {{Chatl|Elly the Camel}}, a camel who is concerned with the cause of camel-care.
* {{Chatl|Father Reen}}, an aerophobic elder who enjoins evil.
* {{Chatl|Ferryman Sathwood}}, who ferries fisherfolk to a far-off frontier. 
* {{Chatl|Gem trader}}, a boulder-bartering businessman.
* {{Chatl|Jarr}}, a sociable citizen who discusses [[Desert Diary|diaries]].
* {{Chatl|Karim}}, who keeps [[Kebab|kebabs]] for commercial causes.
* {{Chatl|Louie Legs}}, a protection-pusher who provides powerful [[platelegs]].
* {{Chatl|Ollie the Camel}}, a conversing camel who hopes to hover to the heavens.
* {{Chatl|Prince Ali}}, recent royalty who was kidnapped by [[Lady Keli|Keli]].
* {{Chatl|Ranael}}, a skillful seller of strengthened [[Skirt|skirts]].
* {{Chatl|Selim}}, a slippery sleuth who seeks out [[Sq'irk|sq'irks]].
* {{Chatl|Shantay}}, a masterly merchant.
* 4 {{Chatl|Shantay Guard|text=Shantay guards}}, who patrol their pathway to prevent payment-free passage.
* {{Chatl|Shop assistant (Al Kharid)|text=Shop assistant}}, who assists in auctioning appurtenances.
* {{Chatl|Shop keeper (Al Kharid)|text=Shop keeper}}, who sells stuff to citizens of the city.
* {{Chatl|Silk trader}}, a dapper dickerer who dabbles in drapery.
* {{Chatl|Sorceress}}, a reticent recluse with a field of fresh fruits.
* {{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|txt=Tool leprechaun}}, a green guy who can store supplies.
* {{Chatl|Zeke}}, a superior [[scimitar]] seller.
